step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents an analytics architecture processing telemetry data from smart TVs. 1. TV icon (UserConsumerTV) sends data to Kinesis Data Streams (KinesisDataStream). 2. Kinesis Data Streams sends data to Kinesis Data Firehose (Firehose). 3. Kinesis Data Firehose branches to stream raw data into Amazon S3 (S3) for long-term storage and ingests processed data into Amazon Redshift (RedShift). 4. Amazon Redshift connects to Amazon QuickSight (QuickSight) for data visualization and reporting.

graph.name: Vizio Telemetry and Analytics Architecture
